result:
`bun tools/check-register.ts` found no unsettled risk. Of 436 items, none at Likelihood 3 or higher is open. It also found no settled item without a Verified line, no item Moved Out for a reason other than "plugins/ does not ship it", and no item with two Likelihood values.

The checker reads an entry's status from its last `Status:` line. I listed every entry at Likelihood 3 or higher with more than one Status line. Each of them ends in a settled status (closed, mitigated, or accepted). The ones below have a last status with a caveat or a history worth knowing. Entries at Likelihood 3 or higher with several Status lines that are not listed here end in a plain settled status, such as "mitigated" or "closed" after an earlier "open" or "partial".

**Reply (cure 4)**: RISK-226, 227, 262, 264, 278, 352, 353 and 362
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19.
- **Reason recorded:** After the earlier close, the fault reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327, so the "closed" status did not hold. The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` then beat vanilla on two fixtures and held level on both controls. RISK-227 credits the output style plus the redact guard (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6).

**RISK-497** (reply, Likelihood 4)
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19.
- **Reason recorded:** Line 3 beat vanilla on the tuning fixture (r497i 6/6 vs 0/6) and on an untouched fixture (r497a 4/6 vs 0/6). It held the control r497ac at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- **History:** An agent-written "accepted" status was reversed to open. Accepting a risk is the user's call (issue #57).

**RISK-185** (delegation, Likelihood 3), **RISK-451** (verification, Likelihood 4) and **RISK-171** (delegation, Likelihood 4)
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19.
- **Reason recorded:**
  - RISK-185: an output-style paragraph has the agent read a background command's output before replying. It beat vanilla on r185a and r185b and held the r185c control.
  - RISK-451: an output-style paragraph on background exit status beat vanilla on r451a and r451d and held the r451c control.
  - RISK-171: the consent paragraph in the output style plus Artemis, Athena and Heracles beat vanilla on r171b and r171d and held both controls.
- **History:** RISK-185 and RISK-451 each had an agent-written "accepted" status that was reopened for the same reason as RISK-497. RISK-171 had an earlier acceptance that was withdrawn.

**RISK-393** (cost, Likelihood 3) and **RISK-391** (cost, Likelihood 3)
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19.
- **Reason recorded:** The settings fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one earlier versions wrote, so a paid `claude -p` run meets the normal permission prompt.
- **History:** An earlier acceptance was withdrawn, because it was the user's to give.

**RISK-186** (delegation, Likelihood 5)
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19 (RISK-499, issue #45).
- **Reason recorded:** The rebuild's own Bash wrapper made every git command in an isolated worktree get refused. A command naming git is now left unwrapped.
- **Residual:** Model-written expansions are still refused. No hook can reach them. The entry keeps Likelihood 5 and Impact 2 for those.

**RISK-463** (verification, Likelihood 3)
- **Current status:** closed 2026-11-19.
- **Reason recorded:** The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs on two fixtures, for both vanilla and claudetto.
- **History:** An agent-written "accepted" status was reopened.

**RISK-416** (edit, Likelihood 5)
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19.
- **Reason recorded:** One line in the output style and in `Heracles.md` asks for a single `perl -pi` call when one change repeats across files. The first edit method was perl in 3 of 3 runs.
- **History:** It was closed, then reopened after a dogfood run where `xargs sed -i` failed on BSD flags.

**RISK-132** (handover, Likelihood 4)
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19, but only for options the user refused. Those are kept word for word in `hooks/handover/text.ts:14`.
- **Reason recorded:** For an option the agent ruled out alone, the entry records "accepted": the next session rechecks it against the code. The Verified line notes the 2026-11-19 dogfood handover was not re-read.

**RISK-067** (guards, Likelihood 4)
- **Current status:** mitigated 2026-11-19 for git (the ask rules) and for `rm` (Claude Code's own refusal of dangerous `rm`).
- **Reason recorded:** The disk-cleanup part has no control and rests on one report. Residual likelihood is 2.
